note: Dues of plans part-paid on old versions must stay the same after an update
Dues must match on the member app, the phone panel and the laptop panel
Paise amounts (499.50) must add up exactly; a zero total leaves nothing to part-pay
'Received on' keeps the day the sheet was opened; money typed after midnight lands on yesterday unless changed, and so in yesterday's or last month's total
Receipt number comes from the device series when offline; a retry with a changed amount is refused as already saved
The sheet words are plain text in the code, not passed through the translate helper used on the member page; whether another language reaches them was not checked
Money box holds total, received, QR block, two-column paid-by and reference, date and the due line
